## What Business Software Can You Build With One Prompt?


**Your Business. Your Workflows.** Taskade Genesis builds a working app for your business from one prompt: a portal for your clients, a dashboard for your team, or both. Taskade EVE builds the projects that hold your data, AI agents that read that data, and automations that act on it. The app runs live in your workspace.


You need Taskade builds


A portal for your clients Sign-in, their projects, files, and invoices in one place.


A dashboard for your team Today's jobs, open deals, and what is late.


Your data, connected Customers, jobs, and invoices that link to each other.


Work that runs on its own AI agents that answer, and automations that send the reminder.


Here is the prompt from this week's product update:


> Build an app for my business that connects customers, jobs, invoices and my team. Link each job to its customer and each invoice to its job. Show today's jobs first and flag overdue invoices. Add client sign-in, and tell me how to test it with a second account.


[Try this prompt →](https://www.taskade.com/create?prompt=Build%20an%20app%20for%20my%20business%20that%20connects%20customers%2C%20jobs%2C%20invoices%20and%20my%20team.%20Link%20each%20job%20to%20its%20customer%20and%20each%20invoice%20to%20its%20job.%20Show%20today%27s%20jobs%20first%20and%20flag%20overdue%20invoices.%20Add%20client%20sign-in%2C%20and%20tell%20me%20how%20to%20test%20it%20with%20a%20second%20account.&entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Fyour-business-software)

## How Do Your Clients Sign In to Your App?


**Your App. Your Clients.** Every Taskade Genesis app can give your clients their own sign-in, on every plan, Free included. Publish the app and choose **Each person signs in** . Clients create an account, or you add them by email on the **App users** tab.


Under **Who can open it** in the **Publish** menu, pick one choice:


Choice What visitors do Plan


**Anyone with the link** Open the app. No account needed. Every plan


**Each person signs in** Sign in with their own account. Under **Who can join** , you choose who can create one. Every plan


Add your first client in three steps:


1. Click **Publish** , then choose **Each person signs in** .
2. Under **Who can join** , keep sign-up open or make it invite-only.
3. Open **App settings → People & access → App users** , and add the client by email.


Sign-in confirms who a client is. It does not split the rows between clients. To show each client only the rows that match their login, turn on **Private entries** . Find it under **More options** on the live app. Pick the owner field, then test with a second account.[Learn: App Users](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/app-users) and[Learn: Build a Customer Portal](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/build-customer-portal) walk through each step.


New this week: if your app has no sign-in screen, some of its lists cannot show or save data. The **Publish** menu now tells you how many lists are locked, and offers **Add sign-in with EVE** . See[Locked lists](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/publishing#locked-lists-in-an-app-with-no-sign-in-screen) .


**Your domain.** Put the app on your own domain on Pro and up. Pro connects up to 10 custom domains, and Business and up connect unlimited custom domains. See[Learn: Custom Domains](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/custom-domains) .


## How Does Your Team Build in the Same Workspace?


**Your Workspace. Your Team.** Your team joins your workspace as members. They build and change the app with you, and your AI agents work beside them on the same projects. Your clients use the published app. They never see your workspace.


Workspace members App Users


**Who** You and your team Your clients and customers


**What they use** Projects, AI agents, automations, and settings Only the app screens you publish


**How they join** A workspace invite Sign-up, or you add them by email


Free includes 2 workspace members, and Pro includes up to 10. See[Learn: Invite People to Your Workspace](https://www.taskade.com/learn/account/invite-members) and[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) for how projects, agents, and automations feed each other.

## Frequently Asked Questions


What business software can I build with Taskade Genesis?


A working app for your business, from one prompt. For example, a client portal, a CRM, an invoice tracker, a sales pipeline, or a maintenance tracker. Each app comes with the projects that hold your data, AI agents that read that data, and automations that act on it.


Can my clients sign in to my app?


Yes, on every plan, Free included. Publish the app and choose **Each person signs in** . Clients sign up, or you add them by email in[App Users](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/app-users) . Sign-in confirms who a client is. To show each client only the rows that match their login, turn on **Private entries** . Then pick the owner field, and test with a second account.


Are App Kits free to clone?


A kit with no price and no PRO badge clones free, on every plan. A kit with a PRO badge clones into a workspace on a paid plan. The six kits in this post carry a PRO badge.[Learn: Browse and Clone Community Apps](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/community-gallery) shows each step.


Can I use my own domain for my app?


Yes, on Pro and up. Pro connects up to 10 custom domains, and Business and up connect unlimited custom domains. Client sign-in does not need a custom domain. It works on every plan.


How do my team and my clients differ in Taskade?


Your team joins your workspace as members and builds the app with you. Your clients are App Users of the published app. They sign in to the app and do not see your workspace. Free includes 2 workspace members.
